metaDescription: Order custom sublimation medical healthcare items with full-color designs. Perfect for clinics and hospitals. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing lets you apply vibrant, full-color graphics onto polyester-coated medical healthcare items such as lanyards, scrub caps, and face masks. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation dyes bond with the fabric, creating durable, fade-resistant images that won't crack or peel. This makes it an ideal choice for healthcare facilities that want to display detailed logos, photos, or multi-color branding on staff accessories and patient giveaways.
